description: This file defines the IFatalErrorHandler interface in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which specifies methods for handling fatal errors such as unexpected exceptions and fatal exception events.

classes.name: IFatalErrorHandler
classes.description: Interface for controlling how fatal errors are handled, including methods to determine if an exception is unexpected and to handle fatal exceptions.

methods.name: IsUnexpected
methods.description: Determines whether the specified exception is unexpected.

methods.name: OnFatalException
methods.description: Called when a fatal exception occurs, allowing custom handling.
